title: Anthropic makes Claude Cowork, previously available as a "research preview", generally available to all paid plans, and adds six features for enterprise use (Zac Hall/9to5Mac)
summary: Zac Hall / 9to5Mac: Anthropic makes Claude Cowork, previously available as a “research preview”, generally available to all paid plans, and adds six features for enterprise use — Claude Cowork, available on macOS, is losing the “research preview” label today as Anthropic introduces enterprise capabilities.
contentText:
Zac Hall / 9to5Mac :

Anthropic makes Claude Cowork, previously available as a “research preview”, generally available to all paid plans, and adds six features for enterprise use   —  Claude Cowork, available on macOS, is losing the “research preview” label today as Anthropic introduces enterprise capabilities.
